auditCoverage.uiString141: Yipada iwe ti o ti pari tabi ti a ṣe sinu ipo idojukọ, titẹjade, ifilọlẹ, titaja, ati ero iṣowo.
auditCoverage.uiString142: Ṣe ipilẹṣẹ iṣẹ akanṣe kan-pato iṣẹ ṣiṣe iwe-ifiweranṣẹ.
auditCoverage.uiString144: Ṣe ayẹwo awọn ifihan agbara ifilọlẹ iwe ati awọn iṣeduro ayo.
auditCoverage.uiString146: Mura atunyẹwo iwa, ikanni, ati awọn ohun-ini ifilọlẹ ọjọ 90.
auditCoverage.uiString147: Mura awọn faili iwe mimọ, metadata, ẹda-iboju-pada, awọn koko-ọrọ, ati awọn ohun-ini ti o ṣe ifilọlẹ.
auditCoverage.uiString149: Ṣiṣe ẹnu-ọna titẹjade kọja didara iwe afọwọkọ, ideri, metadata, ati awọn faili.
auditCoverage.uiString151: Kọ akọle, apejuwe, awọn ẹka, awọn koko-ọrọ, ati igbasilẹ olùkópa.
auditCoverage.uiString153: Ṣii ero okeere fun PDF, DOCX, ati idii dukia ifilọlẹ atilẹyin.
auditCoverage.uiString160: Ohun-ini ideri ti a ṣe apẹrẹ tabi ti kojọpọ jẹ nilo.
auditCoverage.uiString161: Ka ọrọ iwe afọwọkọ mimọ wa ni isalẹ 90% ti ipari ti o beere.
auditCoverage.uiString162: Padding ti o ni nọmba tabi kikun eewọ ni a rii.
auditCoverage.uiString163: Ti njade ni kiakia tabi scaffold gbọdọ yọkuro ṣaaju okeere.
auditCoverage.uiString164: Oṣuwọn paragirafi pidánpidán kọja ala titẹjade.
auditCoverage.uiString165: Awọn ṣiṣi ipin tun nilo atunṣe.
auditCoverage.uiString166: Nọmba ipin aaye gbọdọ rọpo pẹlu awọn akọle ti o ni ibamu pẹlu iwe-ẹkọ.
auditCoverage.uiString167: Tabili ti akoonu ko pe tabi ko ṣe deede si alaworan naa.
auditCoverage.uiString168: A ṣe iṣeduro atunkọ fun ọna kika yii.
auditCoverage.uiString169: A ṣe iṣeduro bio onkowe fun iwe ti o pari.
auditCoverage.uiString171: Iwe to wulo ati ọna kika okeere ni a nilo.
auditCoverage.uiString172: Ti dinamọ okeere titi di igba ti awọn ọran imurasilẹ ṣe yanju iwe afọwọkọ.
auditCoverage.uiString174: Oko okeere ko le ṣe ipilẹṣẹ. Ise agbese rẹ jẹ ailewu; jọwọ tun gbiyanju.
auditCoverage.uiString175: Awọn alaye iwe ati ipin ni a nilo.
auditCoverage.uiString176: Jọwọ ṣafikun akọle kan, orukọ onkọwe, imọran iwe, ati awọn olugbo ni akọkọ.
